label: P2 mode
help: Choose Timed with guards for scheduled shots with a moisture ceiling and floor rescue.

label: Timed P2 interval
help: Minutes between timed shots; only used by a timed P2 mode.

label: Timed P2 shot size
help: Percent of substrate; zero uses the maintenance shot size.

label: Timed P2 first shot
help: Hours after lights-on before scheduled P2 shots can begin.

label: P2 ends before lights-off
help: Hours before lights-off to enter P3; zero keeps predictive P3.

label: Morning dryback minimum wait
help: Minimum minutes in P0; the low moisture bypass remains available.

label: P0 stall exit
help: Start P1 when reliable dryback is too slow to finish within the maximum wait.

label: EC flush target
help: Continue budgeted flush shots to this target, with a feed EC floor; zero disables.

label: Use zone P2 EC ratios
help: Use each zone dilute ratio instead of the existing 1.2 ratio.

label: P2 dilute EC ratio
help: Dilute above this multiple of the P2 EC target when zone ratios are enabled.

label: Max setpoint move per day
help: Limit automatic moisture setpoint movement in VWC points; zero removes the limit.

label: Setpoint step limit applies to
help: Choose whether the limit also applies to the AI and the learner.

label: Maximum extra ramp shots
help: Choose 1 to 30 extra ramp shots; also raise Maximum ramp shots and retain the daily cap.

label: Timed P2 interval (room default)
help: Minutes between timed shots; only used by a timed P2 mode.

label: Timed P2 shot size (room default)
help: Percent of substrate; zero uses the maintenance shot size.

label: Timed P2 first shot (room default)
help: Hours after lights-on before scheduled P2 shots can begin.

label: P2 ends before lights-off (room default)
help: Hours before lights-off to enter P3; zero keeps predictive P3.

label: Morning dryback minimum wait (room default)
help: Minimum minutes in P0; the low moisture bypass remains available.

label: EC flush target (room default)
help: Continue budgeted flush shots to this target, with a feed EC floor; zero disables.

label: P2 dilute EC ratio (room default)
help: Dilute above this multiple of the P2 EC target when zone ratios are enabled.

label: Maximum extra ramp shots (room default)
help: Choose 1 to 30 extra ramp shots; also raise Maximum ramp shots and retain the daily cap.

label: Rescue misses
help: Alert when rescue shots fail to raise moisture; never holds watering.

label: Rescue misses before alert
help: Consecutive settled rescue shots without a moisture rise before the alert.

label: Rescues past dead feed probe
help: Allow P3 emergency and watchdog rescues past a dead feed probe; bad readings and other interlocks still hold.

label: Manual shot length
help: Test Shot seconds; maximum duration and daily budget still apply.

label: Waste valve rule
help: Choose Close for each shot to close and verify the waste valve before the pump primes.

label: Pump power sensor
help: Optional room=sensor power mapping enables the dead-head alert; never stops the pump.

label: Pump dead-head power
help: Alert after 60 seconds above this power with all valves shut and no active hold or batch.

label: Tank size for estimate
help: Capacity in litres enables the estimate when no tank level sensor is mapped; zero disables.

label: Estimated tank low alert
help: Estimated percentage at which to alert; the estimate never holds shots.

label: Live dryback
help: Read-only: each zone's relative dryback from its peak, with the drop in VWC points beside it; always on, changes nothing.

label: Water vs VPD
help: Keep per grow-day water, quiet dryback rate and VPD records and show how each zone's drying answers VPD (History > Water use); read only.

label: Plant stress card
help: Leaf minus air temperature and leaf VPD on Today and the zone page, where a leaf temperature sensor is mapped in setup (room or zone).

label: CWSI lower baseline
help: Leaf minus air (deg C) of a well-watered canopy, your own; CWSI shows only when the upper baseline is above it.

label: CWSI upper baseline
help: Leaf minus air (deg C) of a canopy that has stopped transpiring, your own; both 0 keeps CWSI off.

label: Shot check
help: off | table (last shots and whether the water landed, zone page) | table_and_alert (also CS-701 from code while the AI assistant is off).

label: Rules
help: Read-only: the doctrine rules with the room's live settings and a bounds-only double-check list.

label: Zone links on notices
help: Each notice names its zones as links, and a merged notice flags every zone it covers; display fix, always on.

label: Before the next shot
help: Read-only list of every pre-shot gate with pass or hold on the zone page; the gates themselves can never be switched off.

label: Runoff estimator
help: off | shadow (publish the room-wide sump water-balance estimate) | shown_alerts (also CS-314 when a grow-day's sealed-room balance does not close) | ai (also a hint to the AI assistant); never waters.

label: Sump litres per run
help: Litres one sump run empties (bucket test); 0 = unknown, then pump flow x run time, else the sealed-room closure.

label: Sump pump flow
help: L/min, used with the run time when the litres per run are 0; 0 = unknown.

label: Runoff reaches the sump within
help: Longest shot-to-sump delay tried (min); the estimator learns the best one.

label: AC and dehumidifier run power
help: An AC or dehumidifier mapped by its power sensor counts as running above this (W).

label: ACs and dehumidifiers
help: Each unit's switch, state or power sensor, mapped in Equipment > Setup for the runoff estimator; read only.

label: Tank readout
help: Optional room display preference; changes no watering.

label: Zones as
help: Optional room display preference; changes no watering.

label: Room climate
help: Optional room display preference; changes no watering.

label: Root-zone temperature
help: Optional room display preference; changes no watering.

label: Today against yesterday
help: Optional room display preference; changes no watering.

label: Room camera
help: Optional room display preference; changes no watering.

label: Equipment lanes
help: Optional room display preference; changes no watering.

label: Zone lanes
help: Optional room display preference; changes no watering.

label: Dryback drivers
help: Optional room display preference; changes no watering.

label: Reference rows
help: Optional room display preference; changes no watering.

label: Day curve in the planner
help: Optional room display preference; changes no watering.

label: Test shot and device states
help: Opt-in zone panel: reviewed controller test shot and read-only mapped device states.

label: Dryback markers
help: Optional relative percent-of-peak markers on short moisture history windows; a 30-day preset is always available.

label: Cultivar
help: Optional cultivar label entered in room setup and copied into each grow record.

label: Long history source
help: Use a tested read-only InfluxDB connection for room history; Recorder remains the default.

label: Record grow days
help: Record one summary per grow-day at lights-on; never changes watering.

label: pH auto-correct
help: Corrects a batch tank that reads outside the feed pH band with a few small doses of the pump in the pH role; locks and alerts if a dose does not work.

label: Pump pH role
help: Which dosing pump raises (pH up) or lowers (pH down) the tank pH; set per pump in Equipment > Dosing > Dosing setup.

label: pH dose length (s)
help: One correction dose, in seconds of the pump's calibrated flow (1-30).

label: pH doses a try
help: The most doses in one correction (1-3).

label: pH mix after a dose (min)
help: Mixing after each dose before the tank is read again (2-30).

label: pH doses a day
help: The most correction doses in one day (1-10).

label: pH stop inside the band
help: How far inside the feed pH band a correction stops (0-0.5).

label: Dim lights on dry substrate
help: Dims a dimmable room light while a zone is dry with the lights on; never off, and restores the brightness it found.

label: Dim below VWC (%)
help: A zone under this VWC counts as dry (1-60).

label: Dim to (%)
help: The brightness the light is dimmed to, never below 30 (30-90).

label: Dim after (min)
help: How long a zone stays dry with the lights on before dimming (1-120).

label: Dim for at most (h)
help: The longest the light stays dimmed before it is restored with a critical alert (0.5-12).

label: Shots held alert (h)
help: A critical alert when a zone that asked for water is held this many hours; 0 = off (0-72).

label: Room leaf temperature
help: Optional sensor mapping in Equipment > Setup; empty on existing and new rooms, read only.

label: Zone leaf temperature
help: Optional sensor mapping in Equipment > Setup; empty on existing and new rooms, read only.

label: Room camera
help: Optional sensor mapping in Equipment > Setup; empty on existing and new rooms, read only.

label: Room CO2
help: Optional sensor mapping in Equipment > Setup; empty on existing and new rooms, read only.

label: Room PPFD
help: Optional sensor mapping in Equipment > Setup; empty on existing and new rooms, read only.

label: Room daily light integral
help: Optional sensor mapping in Equipment > Setup; empty on existing and new rooms, read only.
